definitions.explanation: Items that have been formally decided in a meeting or discussion. A standard business term used in minutes, agendas, and organizational communication.

examples.japanese: {決定|けってい}{事項|じこう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{会議|かいぎ}の{決定|けってい}{事項|じこう}を{議事録|ぎじろく}にまとめた。
examples.english: I compiled the decisions from the meeting into the minutes.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}の{決定|けってい}{事項|じこう}について、{関係者|かんけいしゃ}{全員|ぜんいん}にメールで{共有|きょうゆう}してください。
examples.english: Please share today's decisions with all parties concerned by email.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard meeting and administrative term. Often appears in meeting agendas alongside {審議|しんぎ}{事項|じこう} (matters for deliberation) and {報告|ほうこく}{事項|じこう} (matters for reporting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {決定|けってい}{事項|じこう}を{確認|かくにん}する (to confirm decided matters)
- {決定|けってい}{事項|じこう}を{共有|きょうゆう}する (to share decided matters)
- {決定|けってい}{事項|じこう}に{基|もと}づく (based on decided matters)
